_comment: Hand-edited corrections applied on top of what is read from the college's files. Keys under 'courses' and 'electives' are <batch>-<group>-<term>.

courses._comment: Course names for abbreviations the allocation sheet gets wrong or leaves out. The weekly schedule's spelling of the abbreviation is the key.

2028-core-2.DAIB: Data Analytics and AI for Business

electives._comment: For section-wise schedules: courses that only some students take. They are tagged 'Elective' on the page. Once a student's own choices are loaded, that student sees only the ones they chose.

examAliases._comment: For Exam Seat. A seating plan often writes a subject differently from the course list (an abbreviation, a typo). Each entry maps the plan's spelling to the course's abbreviation or full name as in data/master/courses.json, e.g. "Derivatives Mnagement": "Financial Derivatives". Add entries when a new seating plan is loaded and scripts report subjects they could not place.

defaultSection._comment: For a batch where only one section's list is supplied: every other student of that batch, group and term is in this section. BFS 2025-27, per Khush on 8 Oct 2026: 'Section A list added, others not there would be in Section B'.

sectionFromElective._comment: Stop-gap for a batch whose section list has not arrived: a student with no section gets the one their elective is taught in. Empty now; BFS 2025-27 used it from 8 Oct 2026 until its Section A list came the same day.

students._comment: Extra or corrected student records, merged over what the files give. TEST and TESTA are the dummy rolls for trying the site; "alumni": true marks a student as graduated whatever the timeline says.
